title: Spicy Honey-Brushed Chicken Thighs
description: Make and share this Spicy Honey-Brushed Chicken Thighs recipe from Food.com.

steps.instruction: Combine garlic powder, chili powder, salt, cumin, paprika, and red pepper in a large bowl.
Add chicken and toss to coat.
Place chicken on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray.
Broil chicken for 5 minutes on each side.
Combine honey and vinegar in a small bowl.
Remove chicken from oven and brush with 1/4 cup of the honey mixture.
Turn chicken over and brush with remaining honey mixture.
Broil for 1 additional minute or until chicken is done.
